## Section A - Audit Observations

- No site delivery challan or goods-receipt note was located in the document management system for PO-2026-0355 or PO-2026-0362 at the time of this review.
- No vendor declaration of interest form was located on file for this vendor as required under Procurement Policy MIL-POL-07, Clause 6.2.
